summary: Ideal Power Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a securities purchase agreement for an underwritten public offering of 3,220,961 common shares and pre-funded warrants for 2,070,044 shares at $0.001 exercise price, raising $30 million gross. The offering closed May 18, 2026 under an existing S-3 shelf. Titan Partners acted as placement agent for a 7% cash fee. Directors and officers entered 45-day lock-ups. This is a routine equity financing, not a special situation. No classified M&A, activist, restructuring, or other special event is present.
